title.value: On Generalized Surrogate Duality in Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming
title.justification: The paper focuses on the exploration of generalized surrogate duality within the context of mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP).

analysis.description: This paper explores generalized surrogate duality in Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming (MINLP), proposing an algorithm for computing the best set of aggregations for surrogate relaxations and evaluates its practical performance.

type.justification: The paper conducts extensive computational experiments to evaluate the practical performance of the proposed algorithm in solving MINLPs.
type.quote: We propose a multitude of computational enhancements for improving its practical performance and evaluate the algorithm’s ability to generate strong dual bounds through extensive computational experiments.
